name: Gästehaus Waltraud
beschreibung:
Quietly and sunnily situated in Neustift, Gaestehaus Waltraud delights visitors with comfortable guestrooms and splendid alpine panoramas. Genuine Tyrolean warmth makes everyone feel at ease.

The Stubai Glacier, the Elfer mountain lifts, and local cross-country ski trails are conveniently close.
kurzbeschreibung: Gaestehaus Waltraud in Neustift im Stubaital offers family relaxation facing the glacier peaks.
